(F) Maintenance of Statutory Records:
All Statutory Registers, Records and other Registers as prescribed under various Provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, the Depositories Act,
1996 and the Rules made there under were kept and maintained properly with all necessary entries made therein. Provisions of these Acts were
duly complied with during the period under report.

Depositories (NSDL and CDSL) within the prescribed due dates.
